predecessors.name: Balhae
predecessors.text: the former realm of Balhae (Bohai) in eastern Manchuria: Cliopatria's last Balhae outline (922..925)

successors.name: Liao dynasty (Great Khitan State)
successors.text: the former realm of Balhae (Bohai) in eastern Manchuria: Cliopatria's last Balhae outline (922..925)

ledger.x: 926: the Khitans make Balhae the puppet kingdom of Dongdan.
928: the capital is ordered from Huhan to Liaoyang.

wars.name: Khitan conquest of Balhae and Dongdan
wars.outcome: Liao conquers Balhae in 926, rules it through the puppet king Yelü Bei and his son, and annexes it in 936.

certainty.note: Inherited Balhae outline; the page gives no boundary.
